versions.changelog:
agent-config-manager 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Safely manage OpenClaw agent configurations with built-in validation and rollback support.
- Update agent model assignments, channel bindings, and automate fallback chains.
- Test configuration changes using dry-run without applying.
- Easily add, remove, and bulk update agents with dedicated scripts.
- Back up and restore agent configs automatically or manually.
- Ensure config validity with syntax and model existence checks before apply.
